# Vadim Sokolov

> The website of Vadim Sokolov: research, teaching and books. The books are free to read, and each one has a page with its description and how to cite it. A book with results also has a page with its results and their numbers.

Each book has a Markdown page with its description and how to cite it. A book with results also has its main results on that page and a Markdown page with all its results by chapter with their numbers. A summary of each chapter is linked under the book. The full text is the PDF and the source on GitHub, under CC BY 4.0. When you use a result, cite the book and the number of the result.

## Clinical Trials in Practice: From Foundations to AI Agents

- [Clinical Trials in Practice: From Foundations to AI Agents](https://vsokolov.org/books/clinical_trials_in_practice/index.html.md): by Alexandra Sokolova and Vadim Sokolov (2026). A practical guide to clinical trials as science and as regulated operations: the phases, statistics and design, the daily work of a Phase III study, regulatory submission, and where AI agents belong in clinical development.
- [The book as a PDF](https://github.com/VadimSokolov/clinical_trials_in_practice/releases/download/v1.0.0/clinical_trials_in_practice.pdf): 387 pages, CC BY 4.0
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/VadimSokolov/clinical_trials_in_practice/tree/v1.0.0): the Quarto source, code and bibliography
- [The book as a website](https://vsokolov.org/clinical_trials_in_practice/): every chapter as a page, with search
- [Chapter 1. Historical Context and Evolution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/clinical_trials_in_practice/v1.0.0/summaries/01_historical_context_and_evolution.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 2. Lifecycle of a Clinical Trial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/clinical_trials_in_practice/v1.0.0/summaries/02_lifecycle_of_a_clinical_trial.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 3. Regulatory Framework](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/clinical_trials_in_practice/v1.0.0/summaries/03_regulatory_framework.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 4. Ethical Principles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/clinical_trials_in_practice/v1.0.0/summaries/04_ethical_principles.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 5. Overview of Drug Development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/clinical_trials_in_practice/v1.0.0/summaries/05_overview_of_drug_development.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 6. Economics of a Trial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/clinical_trials_in_practice/v1.0.0/summaries/06_economics_of_a_trial.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 7. Phase I: Human Pharmacology](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/clinical_trials_in_practice/v1.0.0/summaries/07_phase_i_human_pharmacology.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 8. Phase II: Exploratory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/clinical_trials_in_practice/v1.0.0/summaries/08_phase_ii_exploratory.md): summary of the chapter and its results

## On Hilbert's 6th Problem: Probability, Mechanics and Bayesian Computation

- [On Hilbert's 6th Problem: Probability, Mechanics and Bayesian Computation](https://vsokolov.org/books/hilbert6/index.html.md): by Nick Polson and Vadim Sokolov (2026). Hilbert's sixth problem from Kolmogorov's axioms and the Boltzmann equation to the Navier Stokes equations, and the inverse passage: Bayesian estimation on the solution manifold of a differential equation, where the adjoint evolution of the data is a sufficient statistic for linear equations.
- [Results by chapter](https://vsokolov.org/books/hilbert6/results.html.md): 75 results with their statements, status and numbers
- [Catalog of results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/RESULTS.md): 75 results with their statements, status and printed numbers
- [The book as a PDF](https://github.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/releases/download/v1.0.0/hilbert6.pdf): 548 pages, CC BY 4.0
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/tree/v1.0.0): the LaTeX source, code and bibliography
- [Chapter 1. Hilbert's Sixth Problem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/01_hilberts_sixth_problem.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 2. Poincaré: Recurrence, Chance and the Crisis of Physics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/02_poincare_recurrence_chance_and_the_crisis_of_physics.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 3. Axioms of Probability and Large Deviations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/03_axioms_of_probability_and_large_deviations.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 4. Ergodic Theory: From Boltzmann's Hypothesis to Entropy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/04_ergodic_theory_from_boltzmanns_hypothesis_to_entropy.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 5. The Method of Types and Moment Conditioning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/05_the_method_of_types_and_moment_conditioning.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 6. Brownian Motion and Yor's Identities as Algorithms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/06_brownian_motion_and_yors_identities_as_algorithms.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 7. Scale Mixtures, Thorin Measures and Shot Noise](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/07_scale_mixtures_thorin_measures_and_shot_noise.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 8. Entropy, Perelman and the Uncertainty Principle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/08_entropy_perelman_and_the_uncertainty_principle.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 9. Quantum Mechanics: von Neumann, Nelson and Wick](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/09_quantum_mechanics_von_neumann_nelson_and_wick.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 10. Kinetic Theory: Boltzmann, Kac and Propagation of Chaos](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/10_kinetic_theory_boltzmann_kac_and_propagation_of_chaos.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 11. From Boltzmann to Navier Stokes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/11_from_boltzmann_to_navier_stokes.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 12. Navier Stokes as Inference on the Solution Manifold](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/12_navier_stokes_as_inference_on_the_solution_manifold.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 13. The Boundary of the Manifold: Blowup, Turbulence and Steady Flows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/13_the_boundary_of_the_manifold_blowup_turbulence_and_steady.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 14. The Inverse Problem on the Solution Manifold](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/14_the_inverse_problem_on_the_solution_manifold.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 15. Adjoint Sufficient Statistics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/15_adjoint_sufficient_statistics.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 16. Transfer, Generators and Localized Training](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/16_transfer_generators_and_localized_training.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 17. Heat, Navier Stokes and Schrödinger: Examples and Experiments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/17_heat_navier_stokes_and_schrodinger_examples_and_experiments.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 18. Spin Systems, Phase Transitions and Inference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/18_spin_systems_phase_transitions_and_inference.md): summary of the chapter and its results

- [Chapter 20. Filters, Gates and Local Rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/20_filters_gates_and_local_rules.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 21. Kolmogorov, Cybernetics and the Thermodynamics of Information](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/21_kolmogorov_cybernetics_and_the_thermodynamics_of_information.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Chapter 22. Open Problems and the Bridge to Hilbert's Eighth Problem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/22_open_problems_and_the_bridge_to_hilberts_eighth_problem.md): summary of the chapter and its results
- [Appendix A. Lévy Processes, Thorin Measures and Related Classes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/hilbert6/v1.0.0/summaries/A_levy_processes_thorin_measures_and_related_classes.md): summary of the appendix and its results
